voice: Fast, warm, joking Karachi Urdu; switches to English for slang; calls Daya 'Lahori'

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Strong jaw, bright eyes, white teeth, open expression; a small scar on the chin from a bike fall

skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Black polo; slim jeans; white sneakers; or a crisp shalwar kameez on Friday
outfits.by_act: A4=the same through the act; the Rangers raid: a plain shalwar kameez

accessories: Sunglasses on the head; a large fictional-brand watch; a phone in a hard case; a gold ring; a motorbike helmet
tells: Taps the steering lock or his phone when he waits; laughs with the whole body before something violent
gait_notes: Easy, bouncing athlete's walk; takes the space; quick to touch a shoulder; never still
sensitivity: Written as a likeable, ambitious young man whose loyalty is real; no stereotype of Karachi's youth.
